skill_name: Write a short reflective essay about an experience that has changed you.
workflow: One experience that has significantly changed my life is when I decided to travel to India. It was my first time travelling outside of the United States and it was a completely different culture. I was surrounded by unfamiliar faces and customs, and it was both shocking and exciting at the same time.
